title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
title_zh: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in generalist robotic agents have enabled increasingly complex manipulation, yet such strong execution may not necessarily translate into successful task completion without ready access to key task-relevant information in the observation. In such settings, the robot must actively determine what it needs to know, how to obtain that information, and how each new observation should shape what it does next. This may require searching an environment, inspecting objects from informative configurations, or deliberately interacting with the world to reveal its behavior. Current robotic manipulation benchmarks Nasiriany et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026a) ; Tao et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026b) do not demand such open-ended information-seeking physical interactions from the agents and policies. With the increasing preponderance of generalist robotic agents, such exploratory benchmarking becomes pivotal to truly evaluate the zero-shot capabilities of such agents that may encounter unseen challenges in new environments.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型机器人智能体领域的最新进展已使其能够执行越来越复杂的操作，但即便具备如此强大的执行能力，若无法便捷地从观察信息中获取与任务相关的关键信息，也未必能成功完成任务。 在此类情境下，机器人必须主动判断自身需要了解哪些信息、如何获取这些信息，以及每次新的观察结果应如何影响其后续行动。 这可能需要对环境进行搜索、从能提供信息的角度检查物体，或有目的地与世界互动以揭示其行为特征。 当前的机器人操作基准测试 Nasiriany et al. paragraphs.en: Consider a situation where a robot is searching an unfamiliar room in darkness with only a portable light source. The robot can observe only what the light is aimed at. The challenge here comes from the dual use of the same gripper to carry the light and retrieve objects as well. Exploration is also consequential; for example, a searched compartment may contain the target, nothing, or a key that can be used to access other regions. In other words, each observation can change both its beliefs and next possible actions. The robot must therefore decide where to look, how each discovery should redirect its behavior, and when it has learned enough to act. Similar challenges arise beyond search when a robot must determine whether an object has been sufficiently inspected or choose a physical test to probe certain hidden property of an object.
paragraphs.zh: 设想这样一种情况：一台机器人正在黑暗中搜寻一个陌生的房间，而它唯一可用的照明工具是一个便携式光源。 机器人只能观察到光线所照射到的物体。 这里的挑战在于，同一个夹持器既要用来携带光源，也要用来抓取物体。 探索本身也具有连锁效应；例如，一个已搜查的隔间可能包含目标物、空无一物，或者一把可用于进入其他区域的钥匙。 换言之，每一次观察都会同时改变机器人的信念和接下来可能的行动。 因此，机器人必须决定该往何处查看、每次发现应如何调整其行为，以及何时已经获得了足够的信息可以采取行动。 除了搜索任务之外，类似挑战也会出现：当机器人需要判断某个物体是否已被充分检查，或选择一项物理测试来探测物体的某些隐藏属性时。

paragraphs.en: The underlying principle is longstanding. Active and interactive perception study acquiring task-relevant information through decisive actions rather than passively consuming fixed observations Bajcsy (1988) ; Bohg et al. (2017) . However, evaluating this capability requires more than simply hiding information from the initial observation. If every uncertainty has an obvious one-step resolution, successful completion primarily tests if the agent performs that prescribed interaction. Thus, the challenge is beyond simply unveiling missing information, that is autonomously conducting an effective investigation in service of a physical goal, where different actions may expose different evidence. Furthermore, information may need to be accumulated across interactions and acquiring them may affect the state of the task. This question is becoming increasingly palpable as frontier multimodal agents such as GPT-6 Astra can now act directly as robot policies across diverse and previously unseen manipulation tasks without task-specific fine-tuning. Improved execution shifts the bottleneck toward deciding what to investigate, how to investigate it, and when enough has been learned.

paragraphs.en: Thus, we introduce RoboQuest , a benchmark for assessing goal-directed embodied exploration , in which a robot must autonomously gather task-relevant evidence through physical interaction, use that evidence to guide subsequent actions, and decide when it knows enough to commit to a solution. RoboQuest contains ten tasks organized into three families: Search & Explore , Object Inspect , and Testing . These are mobile manipulation tasks set in full kitchens with a mobile manipulator: exploring often means traversing the kitchen as well as precisely manipulating objects. The tasks involve uncertainty about the location and properties of the relevant objects, and making inferences from the outcomes of physical interactions. Rather than instructing the robot with the investigation approach, each task just specifies an externally verifiable physical goal and leaves the investigation strategy to the agent—from evidence gathering steps to conditions of evidence sufficiency and commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出了 RoboQuest——一个用于评估目标导向具身探索的基准测试。在该测试中，机器人必须通过物理交互自主收集与任务相关的证据，利用这些证据指导后续行动，并决定在何时已掌握足够信息以确定解决方案。 RoboQuest 包含十个任务，分为三大类：搜索与探索、物体检查以及测试。 这些是设置在完整厨房环境中的移动操作任务，使用一个移动操作器执行：探索通常意味着既要穿越整个厨房，又要精确操控物体。 这些任务涉及对相关物体位置和属性的不确定性，以及需要根据物理交互的结果进行推理。 与直接指导机器人采用特定的调查方法不同，每个任务仅指定一个可外部验证的物理目标，而将调查策略完全交由智能体决定——从证据收集步骤到证据充分性的判断标准及最终决策。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluations reveal a substantial gap between general manipulation competence and the ability to explore effectively under uncertainty. The best frontier agent succeeds in only 23% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} seldom succeeds. Yet the strongest agents execute most of the required physical actions in isolation when the hidden information is supplied ( Section 4.3 ), and our failure analysis ( Section 5 ) attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. The majority involve exploration and decision making. The agents often stop exploring too early, or prematurely make decisions before observing their ramifications. Their exploration also disturbs the scenes that they rarely prevent or repair. Learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models. These results highlight a persistent gap between stronger robotic execution and the ability to autonomously explore, resolve uncertainty, and achieve a given physical goal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估显示，通用操控能力与在不确定性条件下有效探索的能力之间存在显著差距。 表现最佳的 frontier 智能体仅在 23% 的回合中取得成功，而经过微调的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 几乎从未成功。 然而，当隐藏信息被提供时（第 4.3 节），最强的智能体能够独立执行大多数所需物理动作，而我们的失败分析（第 5 节）指出，只有少数失败与执行有关。 大多数失败涉及探索与决策过程。 这些智能体常常过早停止探索，或在尚未观察到行动后果之前就草率做出决定。 它们的探索行为也会扰乱场景，而这些场景它们很少能够避免或修复。 对大多数模型而言，通过试错进行学习仍然十分困难。 这些结果凸显了更强大的机器人执行能力与自主探索、解决不确定性以及达成特定物理目标的能力之间长期存在的差距。

sents.en: Our evaluations reveal a substantial gap between general manipulation competence and the ability to explore effectively under uncertainty.
sents.zh: 我们的评估显示，通用操控能力与在不确定性条件下有效探索的能力之间存在显著差距。

sents.en: The best frontier agent succeeds in only 23% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} seldom succeeds.
sents.zh: 表现最佳的 frontier 智能体仅在 23% 的回合中取得成功，而经过微调的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 几乎从未成功。

sents.en: Yet the strongest agents execute most of the required physical actions in isolation when the hidden information is supplied ( Section 4.3 ), and our failure analysis ( Section 5 ) attributes only a minority of the failures to execution.
sents.zh: 然而，当隐藏信息被提供时（第 4.3 节），最强的智能体能够独立执行大多数所需物理动作，而我们的失败分析（第 5 节）指出，只有少数失败与执行有关。

sents.en: The majority involve exploration and decision making.
sents.zh: 大多数失败涉及探索与决策过程。

sents.en: The agents often stop exploring too early, or prematurely make decisions before observing their ramifications.
sents.zh: 这些智能体常常过早停止探索，或在尚未观察到行动后果之前就草率做出决定。

sents.en: Their exploration also disturbs the scenes that they rarely prevent or repair.
sents.zh: 它们的探索行为也会扰乱场景，而这些场景它们很少能够避免或修复。

sents.en: Learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.
sents.zh: 对大多数模型而言，通过试错进行学习仍然十分困难。

sents.en: These results highlight a persistent gap between stronger robotic execution and the ability to autonomously explore, resolve uncertainty, and achieve a given physical goal.
sents.zh: 这些结果凸显了更强大的机器人执行能力与自主探索、解决不确定性以及达成特定物理目标的能力之间长期存在的差距。

paragraphs.en: RoboQuest , a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration with ten carefully designed tasks in which exploration shapes subsequent decisions and final task success.
paragraphs.zh: RoboQuest，一个用于目标导向具身探索的基准测试，包含十个精心设计的任务，在这些任务中，探索过程会影响后续决策和最终任务的成败。

paragraphs.en: A systematic evaluation of general-purpose and trained robotic agents , including five frontier multimodal agents and a RoboQuest-finetuned π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , with isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks require and a detailed failure analysis, which together characterize where exploration under uncertainty breaks down.
paragraphs.zh: 对通用型与训练型机器人智能体进行系统性评估，其中包括五种前沿多模态智能体以及经过 RoboQuest 微调的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}，同时分别测试任务所需的执行能力，并进行详细的失败分析，这些内容共同揭示了在不确定性条件下探索机制失效的具体环节。

paragraphs.en: Standard manipulation benchmarks such as RLBench ( James et al., 2020 ) , CALVIN ( Mees et al., 2022 ) , LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , ManiSkill3 ( Tao et al., 2024 ) , RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , BEHAVIOR-1K ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) evaluate multi-task learning and long-horizon motor control. However, these benchmarks operate under complete or immediately accessible task observability, making the objective primarily execution-centric ( Table 1 ). In contrast, RoboQuest focuses on goal-directed embodied exploration: task-critical information is fundamentally absent from initial observations and cannot be resolved by passive viewing, requiring physical interaction to gather evidence before goal completion.
paragraphs.zh: RLBench（James 等人，2020）、CALVIN（Mees 等人，2022）、LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023）、ManiSkill3（Tao 等人，2024）、RoboTwin 2.0（Chen 等人，2025）、BEHAVIOR-1K（Li 等人，2023）和 RoboCasa（Nasiriany 等人，2024；Nasiriany 等人，2026）等标准操控基准测试用于评估多任务学习和长期动作控制。 然而，这些基准测试均在任务信息完全可见或可即时获取的条件下运行，因此其目标主要聚焦于执行（表 1）。 相比之下，RoboQuest 专注于以目标为导向的具身探索：任务关键信息在初始观察中根本不存在，且无法通过被动观察获得，必须通过物理互动收集证据，才能完成目标。

paragraphs.en: In most manipulation benchmarks, relevant information for task progression and completion is always present in the current observation/state, as compared in Table 1 . In RLBench, LIBERO, and CALVIN, the agent must exercise the correct motor skills, but need not explore to uncover some necessary information. In contrast, every RoboQuest task requires information acquisition. Moreover, success still depends on perception and motor execution as well. Aggregate success rates therefore cannot isolate and probe a single capability. Hence, we analyze every episode in full to examine what evidence the agent gathered, retained, and used before it committed to some action ( Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在大多数操控基准测试中，与任务推进和完成相关的信息始终存在于当前观察/状态中，如表 1 所示。 在 RLBench、LIBERO 和 CALVIN 中，智能体必须运用正确的运动技能，但无需通过探索来发现某些必要信息。 相比之下，每个 RoboQuest 任务都需要获取信息。 此外，成功仍然取决于感知和运动执行能力。 因此，综合成功率无法单独隔离和检验某一项特定能力。 因此，我们对每一集进行完整分析，以考察智能体在执行某个动作之前收集、保留和使用了哪些证据（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: When task relevant information is not immediately observable, robots must rely on active perception to acquire missing information ( Bohg et al., 2017 ) . While recent benchmarks investigate camera repositioning ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , visual occluders ( Li et al., 2026b ) , container retrieval ( He et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , or history retention ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , they restrict active sensing to viewpoint adjustment or single-step un-occlusion. RoboQuest expands physical exploration into three dimensions: directed search, active inspection, and interactive testing. These exploratory interactions can alter the environment in irreversible ways, forcing agents to reason about the consequences of their actions.
paragraphs.zh: 当任务相关信息无法直接观察时，机器人必须依赖主动感知来获取缺失的信息（Bohg 等人，2017）。 尽管近期的基准测试研究了摄像头重新定位（Liu 等人，2026b；Liu 等人，2026a）、视觉遮挡物（Li 等人，2026b）、容器取回（He 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026a）或历史记录保留（Chen 等人，2026a），但它们将主动感知限制在视角调整或单步消除遮挡的范围内。 RoboQuest 将物理探索扩展到了三维空间：定向搜索、主动检查和交互式测试。 这些探索性交互可能以不可逆的方式改变环境，迫使智能体推理其行动所带来的后果。

paragraphs.en: Robotic foundation models either employ frontier multimodal models as zero-shot high-level planners ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) or train Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for direct low-level control ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . Existing evaluations test both paradigms in fully observed scenes. When information must be actively gathered, reasoning agents often prematurely commit or hallucinate unobserved states, while Markovian VLAs struggle with multi-step hypothesis testing. RoboQuest provides an architecture-neutral benchmark to evaluate both paradigms under physical uncertainty.

paragraphs.en: RoboQuest is a collection of ten tasks—detailed in Appendix D —requiring information-seeking physical interactions for successful completion. As visualized in Fig. 1 the information seeking interactions constitute three dominant types: search, inspect, and test. In Search tasks, the missing information is the location of some object. In Inspect tasks, it is some hidden information about an object, and the agent reveals it by interacting with the object: turning, lifting, or opening it. In Test tasks, the agent cannot observe the hidden information directly. Thus, it must run a series of trials and identify the relevant cue from the outcomes: an impression, a balance, a rolling ball, or a part that moves. We discuss the capabilities required to carry out these tasks in Section 3.3 and from that lens we also analyze the potential failure modes in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: RoboQuest 包含十个任务（详见附录 D），这些任务的成功完成需要依赖信息获取类的物理交互。 如图 1 所示，信息获取交互主要可分为三种类型：搜索、检查和测试。 在搜索任务中，缺失的信息是某个物体的位置。 在检查任务中，缺失的是关于某个物体的隐藏信息，智能体通过与该物体进行旋转、提起或打开等交互来揭示这些信息。 在测试任务中，智能体无法直接观察到隐藏的信息。 因此，它必须执行一系列试验，并从结果中识别出相关线索：例如触感、平衡状态、滚动的球体或可移动的部件。 我们将在第 3.3 节讨论完成这些任务所需的能力，并基于这一视角在第 5 节分析潜在的失败模式。

paragraphs.en: An episode ends when the robot physically presses a SUBMIT button in the scene. This press freezes the score, so only the state at that moment counts, and the agent itself must judge when its evidence is sufficient. Some actions cannot be undone before that point: a cube dropped into a bin stays there, a token shut inside a compartment is locked away, and ink on the final surface is permanent. An episode that ends without a press counts as a failure.
paragraphs.zh: 当机器人物理上按下场景中的“提交”按钮时，一个回合即告结束。 按下按钮会冻结得分，因此只有那一刻的状态有效，而智能体自身必须判断何时其证据已足够充分。 在此之前，某些操作无法撤销：掉入垃圾箱的立方体会留在其中，关进隔间的代币会被锁住，而最终表面的墨水则是永久性的。 未按下按钮而结束的回合计为失败。

paragraphs.en: Each instance is generated from a seed and a setting of the task’s main parameters. The seed fixes the kitchen, the object layout, the materials, and the remaining details. Five tasks also vary occlusion, with every task object in view at the start ( Visible ), some object outside every camera view ( Look ), or some object under a cover ( Uncover ), as detailed in Appendix I . We evaluate on 50 instances per task, which cover every level of the task’s main parameters and together span 18 kitchen layouts and 5 kitchen styles. All agents play the same instances.

paragraphs.en: An episode succeeds if and only if every goal condition holds at the press. For example, every target on the tray or every cube in its correct bin. Since a single wrong unit fails the whole episode, we also measure progress, a per-task partial credit between 0 and 1 defined in Appendix F .

paragraphs.en: To support the training of learned policies, we also release a dataset of successful demonstrations for all ten tasks. The demonstrations are generated by scripted oracles, one per task. An oracle reads the private specification to execute reliably, but its exploration is scripted as that of an agent without this knowledge, since a demonstration that goes straight to the answer would teach a policy nothing about exploration. The oracles open compartments nearest-first until the targets are seen, lift and tilt each vessel to read its label, turn each cube face by face, print test impressions before stamping the final board, weigh parcels on the balance, and test with the ball again after placing a shim ( Table 13 ). In Unfamiliar Containers the oracle visits the boxes nearest-first by route length, and on each box tries the actions its visible knob suggests in a fixed order (a knob on the lid: lift, twist, slide; a knob on a face: pull, press, slide, turn), including on decoy knobs that open nothing; a box that resists twelve tries is left for later. Most episodes therefore contain several failed tries before a box opens.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持已学习策略的训练，我们还发布了一个包含所有十个任务成功演示的数据集。 这些演示由脚本化的“神谕”生成，每个任务一个。 “神谕”会读取私有规范以确保可靠执行，但其探索过程被脚本化为一个没有该知识的智能体的行为，因为直接导向答案的演示无法让策略学到任何关于探索的知识。 “神谕”会按最近优先的顺序打开隔间，直到看到目标；抬起并倾斜每个容器以读取其标签；逐个面旋转每个立方体；在盖印最终板之前打印测试印记；用天平称量包裹；并在垫入垫片后再次用球进行测试（表13）。 在“陌生容器”任务中，“神谕”会按路线长度从最近开始访问盒子，并对每个盒子尝试其可见旋钮所提示的动作，顺序固定（盖子上的旋钮：抬起、扭转、滑动；侧面上的旋钮：拉动、按压、滑动、旋转），包括那些无法打开的虚假旋钮；如果某个盒子在十二次尝试后仍未打开，则留待后续处理。 因此，大多数回合在成功打开盒子之前都会包含多次失败的尝试。

paragraphs.en: The dataset contains 500 episodes for each task, 5,000 in total, amounting to 366 hours of interaction at 20 Hz ( Table 13 ). Episodes last 4.4 minutes on average, about 5,300 control steps, from 1.6 minutes in Puzzle Box to 7.5 minutes in Blackout Search, where the oracle carries a lamp from place to place and searches each one in the dark. The 500 episodes of each task cover its workload levels ( Appendix I ) in equal numbers and spread over the kitchen layouts and styles. No demonstration shares an instance with the evaluation set. Moreover, the evaluation holds out the kitchen styles, which set the textures and materials of the cabinets, counters, and walls, as well as some task configurations, such as certain target patterns in Stamp Composition and bolt-chain configurations in Puzzle Box. Thus, a policy trained on these demonstrations is always evaluated on unseen scenes and configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含每个任务的 500 个片段，总计 5,000 个片段，相当于以 20 Hz 频率运行的 366 小时交互（表 13）。 每个片段的平均持续时间为 4.4 分钟，约 5,300 个控制步；其中，“拼图盒”任务的片段最短，为 1.6 分钟，“黑暗搜索”任务最长，为 7.5 分钟，在该任务中，神谕需要提着灯在各个地点之间移动，并在黑暗中逐一搜寻。 每个任务的 500 个片段以相同数量覆盖了其所有工作负荷水平（附录 I），并分布于不同的厨房布局和风格中。 没有任何演示实例与评估集共享相同的场景实例。 此外，评估过程排除了厨房风格——它决定了橱柜、台面和墙壁的纹理与材料，以及一些任务配置，例如“印章构图”中的特定目标图案和“拼图盒”中的螺栓链配置。 因此，基于这些演示训练出的策略，始终是在未见过的场景和配置上进行评估的。

paragraphs.en: Completing a RoboQuest task requires two kinds of actions. An information-seeking action reveals information that informs later actions, such as those in the last column of Table 2 . A task action directly drives physical progress toward the goal. The two roles can overlap. For example, opening a container may reveal its mechanism and make retrieval possible. These actions draw on four groups of capabilities: evidence acquisition (finding and revealing the missing information), evidence use (integrating and remembering what has been observed), interactive inference (inferring hidden structure from the outcomes of interactions), and action organization (planning action sequences and anticipating their consequences). Appendix E details nine finer capabilities within these groups, and Table 9 marks which of them each task targets.
paragraphs.zh: 完成一个 RoboQuest 任务需要两种类型的操作。 信息获取操作会揭示信息，这些信息为后续操作提供依据，例如表 2 最后一列中的操作。 任务操作直接推动物理上向目标前进。 这两种角色可以重叠。 例如，打开一个容器可能会揭示其内部机制，从而使得物品取回成为可能。 这些操作依赖四组能力：证据获取（寻找并揭示缺失信息）、证据使用（整合并记住已观察到的内容）、互动推理（从互动结果中推断隐藏结构）以及行动组织（规划行动序列并预测其后果）。 附录 E 详细说明了这些组别下的九项更具体的能力，表 9 则标注了每项任务针对的是哪些能力。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RoboQuest in three parts. First, five frontier multimodal models act as zero-shot robot policies through a common visuomotor interface ( Section 4.2 ); this is the primary focus of the work. Second, to separate exploration from execution, the three models with the highest success rates are tested on the execution skills the tasks are built from, each in isolation and with the information the full task would have to discover supplied up front ( Section 4.3 ). Third, a π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} policy fine-tuned on our demonstrations serves as a learned-policy baseline. As a memoryless VLA model, it shows how effectively the standard policy-learning approach performs on tasks requiring exploratory interaction ( Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个部分对 RoboQuest 进行评估。 首先，五个前沿的多模态模型通过一个通用的视觉-运动接口充当零样本机器人策略（第 4.2 节）；这是本工作的主要重点。 其次，为了将探索与执行分离开来，我们将成功率最高的三个模型用于测试任务所依赖的执行技能，每个模型单独测试，并且会预先提供完整任务需要发现的所有信息（第 4.3 节）。 第三，一个基于我们演示数据进行微调的 π₀.₅ \pi_{0.5} 策略将作为学习策略的基线。 作为一个无记忆 VLA 模型，它展示了标准策略学习方法在需要探索性交互的任务中的有效程度（第 4.4 节）。

sents.en: Third, a π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} policy fine-tuned on our demonstrations serves as a learned-policy baseline.

sents.en: As a memoryless VLA model, it shows how effectively the standard policy-learning approach performs on tasks requiring exploratory interaction ( Section 4.4 ).

paragraphs.en: All models run in the same harness, built on the Inspect Robots agent framework Robocurve (2026) and adapted for RoboQuest ( Appendix B ). At each decision the model receives its proprioception, the elapsed simulated time, the number of decisions remaining, and three 512 × 512 512\times 512 images from two scene cameras and a wrist camera. It replies with exactly one of four tool calls ( Table 6 ): ARM moves the gripper, BASE drives the mobile base, WAIT holds both, and STOP abandons the episode. The model chooses how long each command runs, up to 10 seconds of simulated time, and there are no tools that locate or grasp objects for it. Besides a SUBMIT press, an episode ends when the model stops or replies without a tool call, or after 200 decisions. The conversation accumulates for the whole episode, including the model’s earlier reasoning, and only the images are pruned, to the two most recent observations. The system prompt and tools are given in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型都在同一个运行环境中执行，该环境基于 Inspect Robots 智能体框架 Robocurve（2026）构建，并针对 RoboQuest 进行了适配（附录 B）。 在每个决策时刻，模型会接收到其本体感知信息、已流逝的模拟时间、剩余决策次数，以及来自两台场景摄像头和一台腕部摄像头的三张 512×512 图像。 模型会从四种工具调用中精确选择一种作为回应（表 6）：ARM 用于移动夹具，BASE 用于驱动移动基座，WAIT 用于同时保持两者静止，STOP 则用于终止当前回合。 模型自行决定每个命令的执行时长（最多为 10 秒模拟时间），且系统未为其提供任何可定位或抓取物体的工具。 除了按下 SUBMIT 按钮外，当模型停止运行、在未发出工具调用的情况下作出回应，或执行满 200 次决策时，当前回合也会结束。 整个回合的对话内容会持续累积，包括模型此前的推理过程；仅对图像进行裁剪，保留最近两次观察到的画面。 系统提示与工具列表见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: To see how far a learned policy gets on these tasks, and because frontier models are often impractical to deploy for reasons of cost and latency, we also evaluate a supervised fine-tuned (SFT) π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} model ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) , trained on the demonstrations of Section 3.2 and evaluated on the held-out evaluation instances of RoboQuest. The model takes three camera views (left and right base cameras, plus the wrist camera), 16-D robot proprioception, and the task prompt, predicting a subtask label and 20-step action chunks ( 1.0 1.0 s at 20 Hz). Training minimizes a combined objective of flow-matching action loss and causal subtask prediction. Unlike the language-model agents, it acts at the control rate, sending arm, gripper, and base commands at 20 Hz, on the same physics and with the same scoring. At test time, the policy executes closed-loop replanning in the simulator until physical SUBMIT or task timeout. Training and inference procedures are detailed in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 为了了解所学策略在这些任务上的表现，以及由于成本和延迟问题，前沿模型通常难以部署，我们还评估了一个通过监督微调（SFT）训练的 π₀.₅ \pi_{0.5} 模型（Physical Intelligence 等，2025），该模型基于第 3.2 节的演示进行训练，并在 RoboQuest 的预留评估实例上进行评估。 该模型接收三个摄像头视角（左侧和右侧基座摄像头以及手腕摄像头）、16 维机器人本体感知信息以及任务提示，并预测子任务标签和 20 步的动作片段（以 20 Hz 频率执行 1.0 秒的动作）。 训练过程最小化流匹配动作损失与因果子任务预测的联合目标函数。 与语言模型智能体不同，该模型以控制频率执行操作，以 20 Hz 的频率发送机械臂、夹具和基座的指令，并在相同的物理环境中使用相同的评分机制。 在测试阶段，该策略会在模拟器中执行闭环重新规划，直到物理系统提交或任务超时。 训练和推理流程详见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Success rate (SR, in %) is the share of episodes whose goal state held at a valid SUBMIT press. Progress (Prog, in %) is the mean of a per-task, staged measure of how much of the goal state was reached, defined in Appendix F ; it is computed on the final state of every episode, however it ended, and credits partial results in failed episodes. We also record how each episode ended (correct or wrong submission, stop, text answer, or out of decisions) and, for the frontier models, the tokens, monetary cost at list prices, and wall-clock and simulated time per episode. The isolated skill tests report the success rate of each skill.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率（SR，单位：%）是指那些在有效“提交”操作时仍保持目标状态的回合所占的比例。 进度（Prog，单位：%）是每项任务分阶段衡量目标状态达成程度的平均值，具体定义见附录 F；该指标基于每个回合的最终状态进行计算，无论其结束方式如何，并且会给予失败回合中部分结果的认可。 我们还记录了每个回合的结束方式（正确或错误的提交、停止、文本回答或决策超时），而对于前沿模型，还记录了令牌数量、按标价计算的货币成本，以及每个回合的实际运行时间和模拟时间。 独立技能测试报告了每项技能的成功率。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 and Fig. 3 show a clear lead for GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest success rate (SR) overall (23.2%) and on 7 of the 10 tasks. Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Fable 5.1 follow close to one another (11–14%), Gemini 3.8 Flash trails at 2.0%, and mean progress follows the same order. The two open search tasks are hard for every model: no model solves a single Blackout Search episode, and the only Search Room success is one episode of Gemini 3.8 Flash. On the opposite end, Puzzle Box is the easiest task for every model, 44 to 58 points above the next best task for the four stronger models, so we also report the averages without it. Without Puzzle Box, GPT-6 Astra succeeds about 1.9 to 3.1 times as often as Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Fable 5.1. The only task on which another model clearly outperforms GPT-6 Astra is Wobbly Stand, where Opus 5.5 leads in both SR and progress.
paragraphs.zh: 表3和图3显示GPT-6 Astra具有明显优势，其整体成功率（SR）最高（23.2%），并且在10项任务中的7项任务中表现最佳。 Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol和Fable 5.1的表现紧随其后（11–14%），Gemini 3.8 Flash则落后至2.0%，平均进展也遵循相同的顺序。 两项开放搜索任务对所有模型来说都极具挑战：没有任何模型能解决哪怕一个Blackout Search回合，而Search Room唯一一次成功是Gemini 3.8 Flash完成的一个回合。 在另一端，Puzzle Box是所有模型中最简单的任务，对于四个较强模型而言，其得分比次佳任务高出44至58分，因此我们在报告结果时未将其纳入计算。 如果不考虑Puzzle Box，GPT-6 Astra的成功次数大约是Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol和Fable 5.1的1.9至3.1倍。 在唯一一项其他模型明显优于GPT-6 Astra的任务中，即Wobbly Stand，Opus 5.5在成功率和进展两方面均领先。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating the five models on 500 episodes cost $21,352 in total, from $997 for GPT-6.1 Sol to $9,610 for Fable 5.1. GPT-6.1 Sol is by far the cheapest model, both per episode and per successful episode, and GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5 cost about three times as much per success ( Fig. 3 , Table 7 ). Fable 5.1 and Gemini 3.8 Flash are the least economical per success, Fable 5.1 because it is the most expensive per episode and Gemini 3.8 Flash because it rarely succeeds. The models make a similar number of decisions but spend very different amounts of time, and the two GPT models command the longest robot motions ( Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 500 个回合中评估这五个模型总共花费了 21,352 美元，其中 GPT-6.1 Sol 的费用为 997 美元，而 Fable 5.1 的费用为 9,610 美元。 GPT-6.1 Sol 是目前最便宜的模型，无论是按回合还是按成功回合计算都是如此；而 GPT-6 Astra 和 Opus 5.5 每次成功的成本约为其三倍（图 3，表 7）。 Fable 5.1 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是每次成功成本最低的模型：Fable 5.1 是因为其每回合成本最高，而 Gemini 3.8 Flash 则是因为它很少成功。 这些模型做出的决策次数相近，但所花费的时间差异很大；其中两个 GPT 模型所需的机器人运动时间最长（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: The models give up in different ways (last panel of Fig. 3 , Table 10 ). GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol almost always press SUBMIT , but mostly with the task unfinished: only 27% and 16% of their submissions are correct. Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 instead often stop on their own, and Opus 5.5 is the most precise model when it does submit (30%). Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-6.1 Sol run out of the 200 decisions far more often than the others. No model stops because it is done, and no stopped episode had its goal state met. Since the remaining decisions are shown at every turn, a stop and a timeout are two reactions to the same state of little budget and little progress. Opus 5.5 stops with a median of 24 decisions left, where GPT-6 Astra submits what it has and GPT-6.1 Sol runs out. We read the two together as giving up.

paragraphs.en: Task failures on RoboQuest can come from either ineffective exploration or poor manipulation. To separate the two, we test these execution skills in isolation with the three models achieving the highest success rates, GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol. To isolate execution, we remove the need for exploration by providing information normally uncovered during a task, either in the instruction or by placing a single unambiguous target in the scene. We group the evaluated skills into two categories ( Table 4 ). General skills are common across the benchmark, including picking and placing objects on a target and driving the base to an item. Task-specific skills are operations required by individual tasks, such as opening a drawer or cabinet, opening an unfamiliar container from instructions, turning a cube, and sliding a shim under a stand. Each skill test starts directly in front of the target, omits the SUBMIT requirement, terminates once the goal is reached or after 50 decisions, and uses the same harness as the main evaluation ( Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: RoboQuest 中的任务失败可能源于低效的探索或较差的操作能力。 为了区分这两种原因，我们分别测试了这三种成功率最高的模型——GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol——的执行技能。 为隔离执行环节的影响，我们通过提供任务中通常无法获取的信息（这些信息可能包含在指令中，或通过在场景内放置一个明确无误的目标）来消除探索的必要性。 我们将评估的技能分为两类（表 4）。 通用技能在整个基准测试中普遍存在，包括将物体拾起并放置在目标上，以及将基座驶向某个物品。 任务特定技能是单个任务所要求的操作，例如打开抽屉或柜门、根据说明打开不熟悉的容器、旋转立方体，以及将垫片滑入支架下方。 每次技能测试都直接从目标正前方开始，无需执行“提交”步骤，在达成目标或做出 50 次决策后结束，并使用与主评估相同的测试框架（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 4 , all three models demonstrate strong proficiency on general skills. GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5 drive to an object and pick it up in every episode and GPT-6.1 Sol in 90%, while all three place an object on a counter target in 90–95% of the trials. Performance on task-specific skills is more varied. Certain operations achieve consistently high success, such as turning a cube (100%) and opening an unfamiliar container when instructed (90–100%). In contrast, manipulation involving furniture or tight clearances is much harder. Models open a drawer or cabinet in only 30–60% of episodes, retrieve an object from one in 60–70%, and slide the shim under the named table leg in 35–60%. These failures are rarely due to an inability to reach the target. The robot touches the handle in 75–85% of the drawer and cabinet episodes and brings the shim within 3 cm of the leg in 90–100% of trials, demonstrating that the difficulty lies in the final, precise manipulation. Surprisingly, we found that the same models do better on two of these skills inside the full tasks. For example, GPT-6 Astra opens 90% of the compartments it tries there, against 50% in isolation, and needs 10 decisions on average instead of 22 (second finding in Section 5.2 ).

paragraphs.en: This failure highlights the challenge of out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation in goal-directed exploration. The evaluation instances used novel kitchen styles, materials, task mechanisms and target configurations that are not present in the training dataset ( Section 3.2 ). Thus, the benchmark cannot be solved by simply memorizing state-action mappings or trajectory sequences from training data. Because standard VLA architectures such as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} lack explicit episodic memory, minor execution errors in OOD scenes quickly compound, leaving the policy stuck in repetitive loops or idling until the decision horizon expires.
paragraphs.zh: 这一失败凸显了目标导向探索中分布外（OOD）泛化的挑战。 评估实例采用了训练数据集中未出现过的全新厨房风格、材料、任务机制和目标配置（第 3.2 节）。 因此，该基准测试无法通过单纯记忆训练数据中的状态-动作映射或轨迹序列来解决。 由于 π₀.₅ 等标准 VLA 架构缺乏显式的事件记忆，在分布外场景中的微小执行错误会迅速累积，导致策略陷入重复循环或持续空转，直至决策时间窗口结束。

paragraphs.en: Section 4 showed that frontier models fail in most benchmark episodes, even though they reliably execute the underlying physical skills when hidden information is supplied ( Section 4.3 ). However, isolated skill tests cannot determine what fraction of failures are caused by execution errors, nor identify what causes the remaining failures. In this section, we attribute each failure of GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol to its initial point of failure: missing evidence, a wrong decision, a disturbed scene, or a failed action. Interpreting these results alongside the isolated skill tests reveals that the two analyses are consistent: most failures arise from exploration and decision steps, not from execution of skills.

sents.en: We classify failures by the earliest unrecovered breakdown in this loop into four families, two of which arise during physical action:

paragraphs.en: Missing evidence : the evidence required to fulfill a task goal never reached the agent, not because a physical attempt failed, but because it was never explored. For example, the agent stops or commits to a decision with a hiding place never opened, a cube face never turned to a camera, or a parcel never weighed.
paragraphs.zh: 证据缺失：完成任务目标所需的证据从未到达智能体，并非因为物理尝试失败，而是因为从未被探索过。 例如，智能体会停止行动或做出决定，而藏身之处从未被打开，立方体的某个面也从未转向摄像头，包裹也从未被称重。

sents.en: Missing evidence : the evidence required to fulfill a task goal never reached the agent, not because a physical attempt failed, but because it was never explored.
sents.zh: 证据缺失：完成任务目标所需的证据从未到达智能体，并非因为物理尝试失败，而是因为从未被探索过。

sents.en: For example, the agent stops or commits to a decision with a hiding place never opened, a cube face never turned to a camera, or a parcel never weighed.
sents.zh: 例如，智能体会停止行动或做出决定，而藏身之处从未被打开，立方体的某个面也从未转向摄像头，包裹也从未被称重。

paragraphs.en: Wrong decision : the necessary evidence appeared in the agent’s observations, but the agent either acted against it (e.g., misreading a label, or stamping the wrong cell after a test print) or failed to act on it (e.g., spotting a target but never retrieving it, or stopping while unfinished work remained in observation).
paragraphs.zh: 错误决策：必要的证据已出现在智能体的观察结果中，但智能体要么做出了与之相反的操作（例如，误读了标签，或在测试打印后错误地盖印了单元格），要么未能据此采取行动（例如，发现了目标却从未将其取回，或在观察结果中仍有未完成的工作时便停止了操作）。

paragraphs.en: Side effect : the action itself succeeded but disturbed a task-critical object or state without recovery, e.g., tipping a mug to read its label and spilling balls onto the floor, or accidentally knocking over a stand. Whether the agent failed to foresee the consequence or accidentally collided with the object cannot be determined from the data.
paragraphs.zh: 副作用：该动作本身虽然成功，但却干扰了一个任务关键对象或状态且无法恢复，例如，为了读取标签而倾斜杯子，导致球体洒落在地板上，或者意外地撞倒了支架。 根据现有数据，无法判断智能体是未能预见后果，还是意外与物体发生了碰撞。

sents.en: Side effect : the action itself succeeded but disturbed a task-critical object or state without recovery, e.g., tipping a mug to read its label and spilling balls onto the floor, or accidentally knocking over a stand.
sents.zh: 副作用：该动作本身虽然成功，但却干扰了一个任务关键对象或状态且无法恢复，例如，为了读取标签而倾斜杯子，导致球体洒落在地板上，或者意外地撞倒了支架。

sents.zh: 根据现有数据，无法判断智能体是未能预见后果，还是意外与物体发生了碰撞。

paragraphs.en: Execution failure : the decided action was appropriate, but its physical execution failed, e.g., slipping off a handle when trying to open a compartment, missing a grasp, dropping an object, placing an item off-target, or failing to recover a dropped item.
paragraphs.zh: 执行失败：所决定的行动是适当的，但其物理执行失败了，例如，在尝试打开隔间时手从把手上滑脱、未能抓住物体、掉落物品、将物品放置到错误位置，或未能拾起掉落的物品。

paragraphs.en: Appendix J gives the rules at the boundaries between the families.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 J 给出了各家族之间边界的规则。

paragraphs.en: One episode can fail in several ways at once, so we label every unmet requirement of a failed episode as a separate unit, not just the first. If a Search Room episode leaves two of three targets off the tray, one never found and one dropped on the way, it gives two units: the first is labelled missing evidence, the second an execution failure. Each unit is labelled at the first unrepaired error on its own path, the sequence of events that led to that requirement’s final state. Each task defines an ordered list of deterministic rules evaluated on every unit. Each rule tests a verifiable condition, such as whether a compartment was opened, whether an object was visible in the camera observations, or whether a released object landed on the floor. The first rule that matches assigns the failure family to that unit. Appendix J gives the shared measurements and thresholds. The rules of every task and the label of every unit are released with the benchmark. We consider evidence to be observed if it is visible in at least one camera view received by the model. Each failed episode carries equal weight, split over its units, so the episode above counts one half towards each of the two families.
paragraphs.zh: 一个回合可能同时以多种方式失败，因此我们将失败回合中每个未满足的要求都标记为一个独立单元，而不仅仅是第一个。 如果某个搜索室回合中有三个目标中的两个未被放入托盘——其中一个从未被找到，另一个在途中掉落——那么这将产生两个单元：第一个被标记为证据缺失，第二个为执行失败。 每个单元都在其路径上首次出现的未修复错误处被标记，即导致该要求最终状态的事件序列。 每个任务都定义了一个有序的决定论规则列表，这些规则将针对每个单元进行评估。 每条规则都会检验一个可验证的条件，例如某个隔间是否被打开、某个物体是否在摄像头观察中可见，或者某个释放的物体是否落到了地板上。 第一条匹配的规则会将失败类别分配给该单元。 J 附录提供了共享的测量指标和阈值。 每个任务的规则以及每个单元的标签都会随基准测试一同发布。 如果证据在模型接收到的至少一个摄像头视角中可见，我们便认为其已被观察到。 每个失败回合具有相等的权重，并分摊到其各个单元上，因此上述回合将有一半计入两个类别中的每一个。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the result for 931 / 1143 / 1182 units from 384 / 431 / 439 failed episodes of GPT-6 Astra / Opus 5.5 / GPT-6.1 Sol; values for the three models are given in this order throughout. Missing evidence is the largest family for every model (43 / 43 / 46%), followed by wrong decisions (23 / 31 / 25%); together they account for 66–74% of the failures. Execution failures are 21 / 19 / 18% and side effects 13 / 7 / 12%. The hatched parts are failures in episodes that ran out of decisions (8 / 1 / 19%). For GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, more than half of these are hiding places that were never opened. Section 5.2 reads the evidence behind these shares as four failure patterns.

paragraphs.en: Most often, the models stop exploring while parts of the scene remain uninspected. In about half of the failures (45 / 53 / 50%), an object the task needed was never placed ( Table 17 ). In most of these cases (27–29% of all failures), the object remained hidden inside a drawer, cabinet, box, or cover that was never opened. Crucially, the hiding place itself was rarely missed. It typically appeared in the agent’s observations five or more times, while hiding places that were never observed account for only 1–2% of failures. In about a tenth of the failures, the target was fully visible and observed by the agent but never acted on: e.g., a target never fetched, or a dropped object left on the counter.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数情况下，模型会停止探索，而场景中的某些部分仍然未被检查。 在大约一半的失败案例中（45 / 53 / 50%），任务所需的一个物体从未被放置（表 17）。 在这些案例的大多数情况中（所有失败案例的 27–29%），该物体仍然隐藏在抽屉、柜子、盒子或盖子内部，而这些容器从未被打开。 关键在于，隐藏地点本身很少被忽略。 该物体通常会在智能体的观察中出现五次或更多次，而从未被观察到的隐藏地点仅占所有失败案例的 1–2%。 在大约十分之一的失败案例中，目标完全可见且被智能体观察到，但从未被采取行动处理：例如，目标从未被取走，或掉落的物体被遗留在台面上。

paragraphs.en: Beyond stopping exploration early, models also commit to decisions prematurely without gathering sufficient evidence. Roughly a tenth of all failures (9–11%) occurred when models committed objects to locations before observing what was needed to decide correctly. In Odd Parcel, most wrongly selected parcels (71–84%) were boxed before weighings could reveal whether they were odd. In Painted Cubes, marks on uninspected cube faces remained unseen, causing models to misclassify qualifying cubes far more often than unqualified ones (22–37% against 5–10%; Fig. 7 ). In Stamp Composition, 20–23% of incorrectly placed stamps by GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol were printed without a prior test print (compared to 3% for Opus 5.5).
paragraphs.zh: 除了过早停止探索之外，模型还会在未收集足够证据的情况下就仓促做出决定。 大约十分之一的失败（9–11%）发生在模型在观察到正确决策所需信息之前，就将物体分配到了特定位置。 在“奇数地块”任务中，大多数错误选择的地块（71–84%）在被称重以判断其是否为奇数之前就被框选了出来。 在“涂色立方体”任务中，未检查的立方体面上的标记未被观察到，导致模型将符合条件的立方体误分类的频率远高于不符合条件的立方体（22–37% 对比 5–10%；图 7）。 在“邮票组合”任务中，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 错误放置的邮票中有 20–23% 未经预先试印就直接打印（而 Opus 5.5 的这一比例为 3%）。

paragraphs.en: Controlled experiments varying visual occlusion corroborate this exploration bottleneck ( Table 14 ). When task objects start out of view or under a cover, overall success drops by 8–10 points. Crucially, these additional failures fall entirely under missing evidence , while wrong decisions, execution failures, and side effects do not increase ( Table 15 ). In other words, hiding an object makes agents less likely to find it, but no worse at manipulating it once found.
paragraphs.zh: 通过改变视觉遮挡进行的受控实验证实了这种探索瓶颈（表 14）。 当任务对象一开始就处于视野之外或被遮挡时，整体成功率会下降 8–10 个百分点。 关键在于，这些额外的失败完全归因于证据缺失，而错误决策、执行失败和副作用并未增加（表 15）。 换句话说，隐藏一个物体会使智能体更难找到它，但一旦找到，它们操控该物体的能力并不会变差。

paragraphs.en: Execution failures account for 18–21% of all errors, led by off-target placements and drops to the floor. Surprisingly, opening drawers and cabinets, the skill that fails most in isolation, works better in the full tasks. We analysed the compartments holding a target in Search Room and Locked Storage, and find that models open 75–90% of those they attempt, compared to 30–60% in the isolated test ( Table 5 , left). At the same time, the successful opening takes fewer decisions, 10 / 26 / 15 on average, against 22 / 31 / 36 in the isolated test ( Table 12 ). Possibly, the robot has already adapted to the controls in the earlier steps of a full episode, while each isolated test starts from scratch. The other two skills that fail most in isolation improve or hold up in the full tasks as well. When trying to grasp a target in an opened compartment, the models take it out in 79–94% of cases, above the isolated 60–70%. In Wobbly Stand, models place a shim under the short leg in 32–60% of the full episodes, where they must identify that leg themselves, against 35–60% in isolation, where the leg is named.
paragraphs.zh: 执行失败在所有错误中占 18–21%，其中最主要的原因是放置偏离目标以及物品掉落地面。 令人意外的是，打开抽屉和柜门这一在单独测试中失败最严重的技能，在完整任务中的表现反而更好。 我们分析了搜索室和锁定储物空间中存放目标的隔间，发现模型在尝试打开这些隔间时成功率达到 75–90%，而在单独测试中仅为 30–60%（表 5，左侧）。 同时，成功开启所需的决策次数更少，平均为 10 / 26 / 15，而单独测试中则为 22 / 31 / 36（表 12）。 可能的原因是，机器人在完整流程的早期步骤中已经适应了控制装置，而每次单独测试都从头开始。 另外两项在单独测试中失败最严重的技能，在完整任务中的表现也得到改善或保持稳定。 在尝试从已打开的隔间中抓取目标时，模型有 79–94% 的成功率将其取出，高于单独测试中的 60–70%。 在“摇晃支架”任务中，模型在完整流程中有 32–60% 的情况会在短腿下方垫入楔块，此时模型必须自行识别出这条腿；而在单独测试中，由于腿的位置已被指明，这一成功率为 35–60%。

sents.en: Execution failures account for 18–21% of all errors, led by off-target placements and drops to the floor.
sents.zh: 执行失败在所有错误中占 18–21%，其中最主要的原因是放置偏离目标以及物品掉落地面。

sents.en: We analysed the compartments holding a target in Search Room and Locked Storage, and find that models open 75–90% of those they attempt, compared to 30–60% in the isolated test ( Table 5 , left).

sents.en: At the same time, the successful opening takes fewer decisions, 10 / 26 / 15 on average, against 22 / 31 / 36 in the isolated test ( Table 12 ).
sents.zh: 同时，成功开启所需的决策次数更少，平均为 10 / 26 / 15，而单独测试中则为 22 / 31 / 36（表 12）。

paragraphs.en: Side effects account for 7–13% of all errors, representing failures that isolated skill tests cannot capture. In these cases, the model’s intended action succeeds, but inadvertently disrupts a task-critical state. Roughly two-thirds of these errors involve objects falling to the floor where recovery is impossible, such as the test ball in Wobbly Stand rolling off the stand, or balls spilling when a mug in Marked Mugs is tilted to read its label. Emptying the balls is a viable strategy for inspecting the label, and all three models employ it, but they rarely take preventative measures. An empty bowl was provided in each scene for safely holding the balls, but it was used in only 2–8 of the 50 Marked Mugs episodes and never in Wobbly Stand. Furthermore, only 4 of the 38 subsequent attempts to recover a loose ball succeeded.

paragraphs.en: In Puzzle Box, a chain of sliding bolts locks the lid. Without the cover, the blocking dependencies between bolts are directly visible. On the other hand, with the cover, the unlocking sequence must be learned by trying bolts and observing what moves. On matching chain lengths ( Table 5 , right), adding the cover barely affects GPT-6 Astra, which succeeds in 94.4% of episodes without it and 96.4% with it (using 120 vs. 85 decisions). In contrast, Opus 5.5 drops sharply from 94.4% to 36.8%, while GPT-6.1 Sol falls moderately from 72.2% to 60.1%. Roughly half of Opus 5.5’s failed attempts involve pulling a blocked bolt three or more times without updating its plan (12 of 26). The Unfamiliar Containers task requires a similar capability. Given instructions on the opening mechanism, Opus 5.5 succeeds in 90% of isolated trials ( Table 4 ), but when left to discover the mechanism interactively, it opens only 45% of attempted containers in the full task, against 70% and 78% for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
paragraphs.zh: 在“谜题盒”任务中，一系列滑动螺栓将盖子锁住。 如果没有盖子，螺栓之间的阻塞依赖关系就能直接看到。 另一方面，有盖子时，必须通过尝试各个螺栓并观察其移动情况来学习解锁顺序。 在链长匹配的情况下（表5，右侧），添加盖子对 GPT-6 Astra 几乎没有影响：无盖时它在 94.4% 的回合中成功，有盖时则达到 96.4%（分别使用 120 次和 85 次决策）。 相比之下，Opus 5.5 的成功率从 94.4% 骤降至 36.8%，而 GPT-6.1 Sol 则从 72.2% 适度下降至 60.1%。 Opus 5.5 失败的尝试中，大约有一半涉及在未更新计划的情况下连续拉动被阻塞的螺栓三次或更多次（26 次中有 12 次）。 “陌生容器”任务也需要类似的能力。 在提供开启机制说明的情况下，Opus 5.5 在独立测试中的成功率为 90%（表4）；但当需要自行通过互动发现机制时，它在完整任务中仅能打开 45% 的尝试容器，而 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的成功率分别为 70% 和 78%。

paragraphs.en: The importance of RoboQuest is highlighted by the empirical performance and cost of five frontier models. All five generalist frontier physical agents succeed on only a small fraction of episodes: GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate at 23.2%, Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Fable 5.1 follow at 11 to 14%, and Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the lowest at 2%; GPT-6.1 Sol is the most economical per successful episode. Beyond aggregate performance, two complementary analyses show where goal-directed exploration breaks down. When tested in isolation, models succeed on execution skills in 72–81% of attempts, while our failure analysis attributes only 18–21% of failures in the full tasks to execution. The two analyses agree that the bottleneck lies in exploring and decision-making rather than in execution, with most failures resulting from exploration that stops too early. The models stop exploration while parts of the scene remain uninspected, or commit to decisions before acquiring necessary evidence (9–11% of failures). Our controlled occlusion experiments confirm that hiding objects increases missing-evidence errors. Furthermore, physical exploration can have irreversible consequences, disrupting task-critical state in 7–13% of failures, while interactive hypothesis testing remains brittle: covering the locks in Puzzle Box leaves GPT-6 Astra unaffected but cuts Opus 5.5’s success from 94% to 37%. Finally, models diverge in how they end tasks, either submitting prematurely or exhausting their decision budget. Together, these results demonstrate that progress on embodied exploration requires not only stronger perception and control, but also systematic evidence acquisition, persistent goal and evidence tracking, causal hypothesis testing, and robust monitoring and recovery during physical interaction.

sents.en: The prompt for Puzzle Box reads:
sents.zh: 谜题盒的提示内容如下：

paragraphs.en: You control a simulated mobile manipulation robot. Use only the provided camera images, robot proprioception and action/budget feedback. Determine what the goal requires from the scene. Choose exactly one arm, base, wait or stop tool per response. There are no semantic object-location or grasp tools. Images are upright RGB from three fixed cameras; new views require physical robot or object motion. The arm tool controls the right gripper site in world metres, with optional world orientation as quaternion xyzw. World z is up. Gripper -1 opens, +1 closes and 0 keeps its current setpoint. The base tool takes normalized body-frame forward, left and yaw velocity commands; positive yaw turns left. The arm stays relative to the base during base motion. The torso is held. A tick is 0.05 seconds. Commands consume up to 200 ticks each, ending early on the first physical SUBMIT button press. Check observed outcomes: commanded targets are not guaranteed to be reached. Physically press SUBMIT to commit the result; the first press freezes the score and ends the episode immediately. Wrong submission, timeout without submission, or calling stop without submission fails. The stop tool abandons the episode without advancing time. Invalid or multiple tool calls perform no physics and still consume this model response. No intermediate success is awarded. Goal: Open the wooden puzzle box on the counter, take out the tangerine inside, and stand it inside the tray. The lid slides sideways but is locked by sliding bolts with round black handles: a part moves only when nothing blocks it, so work out the order. Any order that works is fine. Once the tangerine is inside the tray and you have let go of everything, press the red SUBMIT button. Your first submission ends the episode; a wrong submission or no submission fails.

paragraphs.en: At each step, the model must reply with exactly one tool call and specify the action’s duration in simulation ticks. An ARM command servos the gripper toward the target pose using the robot’s operational-space controller. A BASE command applies body-frame velocities at each tick while holding the arm fixed relative to the base, and WAIT holds both. Each command runs for exactly its requested ticks, with no additional settling time. Commands terminate early only if the physical SUBMIT button is pressed.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一步中，模型必须仅回复一个工具调用，并指定该动作在模拟中的持续时间（以模拟时间步为单位）。 ARM 命令通过机器人的操作空间控制器，将机械臂的末端执行器调整至目标姿态。 BASE 命令在每个时间步施加本体坐标系下的速度，同时保持机械臂相对于基座的固定位置；WAIT 命令则使两者均保持静止。 每个命令的运行时间严格等于其请求的时间步数，不会有任何额外的稳定时间。 只有当物理 SUBMIT 按钮被按下时，命令才会提前终止。

paragraphs.en: Each episode begins with a fresh conversation context, with no memory retained across episodes. Within an episode, each turn appends the observation, the model’s full response (including its reasoning), and the tool execution result to the dialogue history. While the complete textual history is preserved, the image history is pruned, retaining only the two most recent observations consisting of six images in total.
paragraphs.zh: 每一轮都从全新的对话上下文开始，不同轮次之间不会保留任何记忆。 在一轮中，每次交互都会将观察结果、模型的全部响应（包括其推理过程）以及工具执行结果追加到对话历史中。 虽然完整的文本历史会被保留，但图像历史则会进行裁剪，仅保留最近两次观察结果，总计包含六张图像。

paragraphs.en: Our training simultaneously optimizes an autoregressive language modelling objective for subtask prediction and a conditional flow-matching objective for low-level action chunking:

paragraphs.en: where ℒ subtask \mathcal{L}_{\text{subtask}} is the cross-entropy loss over causal subtask tokens, and ℒ flow \mathcal{L}_{\text{flow}} is the flow-matching loss conditioned on vision, state, prompt, and the teacher-forced subtask.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，ℒ subtask \mathcal{L}_{\text{subtask}} 是因果子任务标记上的交叉熵损失，而 ℒ flow \mathcal{L}_{\text{flow}} 是在视觉、状态、提示和教师强制子任务条件下计算的流匹配损失。

paragraphs.en: Storage compartments open only when a matching access token rests on their reader. Tokens are either outside the initial observation or hidden inside other storage, and some compartments contain tokens for other compartments, forming a dependency chain. The goal is to retrieve the target item. Finding a token changes which places can be searched next. Closing a compartment with a token still inside locks that token away permanently, so the robot must plan token handling as well as search order.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当匹配的访问令牌放置在读取器上时，存储格才会打开。 令牌要么位于初始观察范围之外，要么隐藏在其他存储格内，并且某些存储格包含用于其他存储格的令牌，从而形成依赖链。 目标是取回目标物品。 找到一个令牌会改变接下来可以搜索的位置。 如果将仍含有令牌的存储格关闭，该令牌将被永久锁住，因此机器人必须同时规划令牌的处理方式和搜索顺序。

paragraphs.en: A search task is performed in an unlit room. Only a light source with a glow marker and the SUBMIT button are visible at the start. The robot must acquire the light source, carry it, and search using a wrist camera that sees only what is illuminated. Because one gripper holds the light, retrieving a target requires putting the light down while aiming it at the target, then acting from memory in the dark.

paragraphs.en: Several identical vessels, all mugs or all bowls in a given instance, each hold loose contents, and a label on the underside of each vessel specifies its destination. The goal is to place every vessel upright at its destination with its original contents inside. Reading a label requires lifting or tilting the vessel, which spills the contents. Spilled contents stay nearby and must be returned to the correct vessel before submission.
paragraphs.zh: 在某个给定实例中，多个相同的容器（全部是杯子或全部是碗），每个容器都装有松散的物品，而每个容器底部的标签则标明了其目的地。 目标是将每个容器直立地放置在其目的地，并确保其原始物品仍在内部。 要读取标签，需要抬起或倾斜容器，这会导致物品洒出。 洒出的物品会留在附近，在提交前必须将其放回正确的容器中。

paragraphs.en: Goal text: “There are ⟨ \langle stamps ⟩ \rangle on the counters in this kitchen. Stamp the final board so it shows exactly the pattern on the reference card, then press Submit . The final board is the blue-bordered one with the printed 3x3 grid; the green-bordered reference card is not for stamping. The round self-inking stamps stand face down on the work surface. Each prints a fixed pattern of dots in whatever direction it is held, and the unmarked housings show neither the pattern nor which way it points, so try them on the tan scratch board. Ink stays where it lands, on the scratch board and on the final board alike. Fill exactly the reference card’s grid cells with no ink outside the final board’s grid, put every stamp back down on the counter and let go, then press the red SUBMIT button. Your first submission ends the episode; a wrong submission or no submission fails. Other objects on the counter are not part of the task; you may move them if needed.”
paragraphs.zh: 目标文本：“这个厨房的台面上有 ⟨ \langle 印章 ⟩ \rangle。 在最终板上盖章，使其完全呈现出参考卡上的图案，然后按下“提交”按钮。 最终板是带有蓝色边框且印有 3x3 网格的板；绿色边框的参考卡不可用于盖章。 圆形的自印印章正面朝下立在操作台上。 每个印章无论以何种方向持握，都会印出固定的点状图案；未标记的外壳既不会显示图案，也不会显示其朝向，因此请先在浅棕色试错板上尝试使用。 墨水会留在它落下的位置，无论是在试错板上还是在最终板上。 仅用墨水填满参考卡上的网格单元格，且不能超出最终板的网格范围；将每个印章放回台面上并松手，然后按下红色的“提交”按钮。 你的第一次提交将结束本环节；提交错误或未提交则视为失败。 台面上的其他物品并非任务的一部分；如有需要，你可以移动它们。”

paragraphs.en: A container is held closed by a chain of interlocking parts, where each part blocks another until it is moved. All parts are visible with large handles, but the blocking relations are not. The goal is to place the item inside on the tray. The robot must discover the release order by trying moves and observing what moves, and some wrong moves jam another part until reversed.
paragraphs.zh: 一个容器通过一系列相互锁合的部件保持关闭，每个部件都会阻碍另一个部件，直到其被移动。 所有部件都配有大型把手，清晰可见，但彼此之间的阻碍关系却不可见。 目标是将物品放入托盘内部。 机器人必须通过尝试各种动作并观察结果来发现解锁顺序；某些错误动作会使其他部件卡住，直到被反向操作解除。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 lists the capabilities each task targets. Directed search is the core of the Search family, active perception of the Inspect family, and experimental identification of the Test family. Evidence integration and memory are needed wherever an observation only matters together with earlier ones. Affordance discovery is targeted in Unfamiliar Containers, where the hidden property is how each box opens. paragraphs.en: Each target earns a third of its credit once its compartment is open, two thirds once it has been taken out, and full credit once it stands upright on the tray, released. A target under a cloche or on the open counter earns nothing for opening. Credit for opening and taking out is kept even if the agent later closes the compartment or drops the target. P P is the mean credit over the targets, less 0.1 if a non-target object is on the tray. A compartment counts as open at 15% of its joint range, which is 0.15 m for a drawer and 0.24 rad for a door. paragraphs.zh: 每个目标在其隔间打开后获得三分之一的积分，被取出后获得三分之二的积分，在托盘上直立并被释放后则获得全部积分。 位于罩子下或开放台面上的目标在打开时不会获得任何积分。 即使智能体后来关闭了隔间或放回了目标，打开和取出的积分仍会被保留。 P P 是所有目标的平均积分，如果托盘上有非目标物体，则减去 0.1。 当隔间开启至其关节活动范围的 15% 时即被视为已打开，对于抽屉而言为 0.15 米，对于门而言为 0.24 弧度。 一旦目标离开其隔间或罩子，或者从开启位置移动了 0.15 米，即被视为已被取出。

paragraphs.en: Every skill-test scene keeps the kitchen of an evaluation instance and holds only one object and its target from that task, with no SUBMIT button. The simulator checks the test’s goal after every physics tick and ends the episode once the goal has held for 0.5 s. Otherwise the episode ends after 50 decisions. Success is scored from the recorded episode by the source task’s own rule for that stage. The scenes vary what the skill depends on, such as straight and detour routes for driving or the eleven opening mechanisms of the containers. Every model plays the same 20 scenes per skill.
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能测试场景都会保留一个评估实例的厨房，其中仅包含该任务中的一个物体及其目标，且没有“提交”按钮。 模拟器会在每次物理模拟步骤后检查测试目标，并在目标状态持续 0.5 秒后结束该回合。 否则，该回合将在做出 50 次决策后结束。 成功与否将根据源任务针对该阶段的规则，从记录下来的回合中评分。 这些场景会变化技能所依赖的因素，例如驾驶时的直线路径与绕行路线，或容器的十一种开启机制。 每个模型都会针对每项技能完成相同的 20 个场景。

paragraphs.en: Every task ends by placing objects on or into a target on the counter, such as a tray or a bin. Most tasks also require driving the base to an object, the Search tasks most of all. paragraphs.en: Table 12 gives the two execution stages of retrieving a hidden target in the full tasks, beside the isolated test of the same skill ( Section 5.2 ). A compartment counts as tried when the robot has touched or when the gripper closed within 12,cm of its handle. A grasp counts as tried when the robot has touched the target, or when the gripper closed within 12,cm of it. Decisions per opening are averaged over successful openings, from the last decision with the robot base at least 0.2 m from the compartment’s standing position, where the isolated test starts. Decisions are compared only for opening, because there the two settings start alike. Placing a shim in the full tasks includes finding the short leg and the right shim, while the isolated test names the leg and provides a single shim. paragraphs.zh: 表 12 展示了在完整任务中检索隐藏目标的两阶段执行过程，以及同一技能的独立测试（第 5.2 节）。 当机器人接触该隔间，或夹爪在其把手 12 厘米范围内闭合时，该隔间即被视为已尝试。 当机器人接触目标，或夹爪在其 12 厘米范围内闭合时，一次抓取即被视为已尝试。 每次开启的决策数基于成功开启的次数进行平均计算，且从机器人底座距离隔间站立位置至少 0.2 米时的最后一次决策开始，此时独立测试也由此启动。 仅对开启阶段的决策进行比较，因为在这一阶段两种设置是相同的。 在完整任务中，取出目标的过程从模型开启隔间的任意位置开始，并包含寻找目标这一环节。 在完整任务中，放置垫片包括找到短腿和正确的垫片，而在独立测试中，短腿的位置已指定且仅提供一个垫片。 对于盒子而言，独立测试会指定开启机制，而在完整任务中，模型必须通过尝试来找到该机制。

paragraphs.en: Every frame stores the three camera views, the robot state, the action, and two levels of language annotation. A stage such as “Open and look inside the nearer of the two boxes on your right” contains finer subtasks such as “Try pulling the knob on the front of the box”. Objects are named only by their appearance and position as seen from the robot at that moment. Hidden information is never named before the robot has seen it. For example, an item in a closed box is not named until the box is open. Every control step belongs to exactly one subtask. Stages last 10 to 50 s and subtasks about 10 s, and Table 13 gives the mean number of subtasks per task.
paragraphs.zh: 每一帧都存储了三种摄像头视角、机器人状态、动作以及两个层级的语言标注。 一个阶段，例如“打开并查看你右侧两个箱子中较近的那个箱子的内部”，包含更细的子任务，例如“尝试拉动箱子正面的旋钮”。 物体的命名仅基于机器人当时看到的外观和位置。 在机器人看到隐藏信息之前，这些信息绝不会被命名。 例如，一个位于封闭箱子中的物品，在该箱子打开之前不会被命名。 每个控制步骤都恰好属于一个子任务。 各阶段的持续时间为 10 到 50 秒，子任务的持续时间约为 10 秒，表 13 给出了每个任务的平均子任务数量。

paragraphs.en: We attribute failures per requirement rather than per episode, as a single episode can fail in multiple ways. An episode’s requirements contains both its goal objectives (such as each target that must reach the tray) and its task constraints (such as keeping other objects off the tray). Each unmet requirement serves as an individual unit of analysis in our attribution procedure ( Algorithm 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将失败归因于单个需求而非单个回合，因为一个回合可能以多种不同方式失败。 一个回合的需求既包括其目标（例如必须到达托盘的每个目标对象），也包括其任务约束（例如将其他物体保持在托盘之外）。 在我们的归因流程（算法 1）中，每个未满足的需求都作为一个独立的分析单元。

paragraphs.en: Each unmet requirement in the final simulator state of an episode constitutes one unit, such as a target left off the tray or an incorrect stamp cell. When a single error leaves multiple requirements unmet, each requirement is treated as a distinct unit and attributed independently. Across all tasks, this yields 931 units for GPT-6 Astra from 384 failed episodes, 1,143 for Opus 5.5 from 431, and 1,182 for GPT-6.1 Sol from 439.
paragraphs.zh: 每个回合最终模拟状态中未满足的需求都构成一个单位，例如托盘上遗漏的目标或错误的盖章单元格。 当单个错误导致多个需求未满足时，每个需求都被视为独立的单位并独立归因。 在所有任务中，GPT-6 Astra 在 384 次失败回合中产生了 931 个单位，Opus 5.5 在 431 次失败回合中产生了 1,143 个单位，而 GPT-6.1 Sol 在 439 次失败回合中产生了 1,182 个单位。

paragraphs.en: Each failed episode carries equal weight, split evenly across its units. We compute each family’s share as the weighted fraction of its units. We also tried another aggregation scheme by pooling all units and averaging the ten per-task shares. Under both schemes, missing evidence remains the largest family for every model. Missing evidence and wrong decisions together account for 66–78% of failures, and no family share shifts by more than 7 percentage points ( Table 16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个失败的回合都具有相同的权重，并均匀分配给其各个单元。 我们将每个家族的份额计算为其单元加权的比例。 我们还尝试了另一种聚合方案：将所有单元合并，然后对每个任务的十份份额取平均值。 在这两种方案下，缺失的证据在每个模型中仍然是最大的家族。 缺失的证据和错误的决策共同导致了 66%–78% 的失败，且没有任何一个家族的份额变化超过 7 个百分点（表 16）。

paragraphs.en: Attribution relies on data logged during execution: the simulator state recorded at every 20 Hz tick and the three camera views delivered to the model at each decision step. Replaying these simulator states reproduces the exact scene geometry, allowing us to render ground-truth segmentation masks for each delivered observation. These masks identify the visible pixels of each object and key features (e.g., cube markings or container labels), whose pixel brightness is measured directly from the delivered images. From the physical trajectory, we also extract interaction events, including grasps, drops, final resting poses, opened compartments, and stamped ink impressions.
paragraphs.zh: 归因依赖于执行过程中记录的数据：即每 20 赫兹时间步长记录的模拟器状态，以及模型在每个决策步骤接收到的三个摄像头视角。 重播这些模拟器状态可以重现精确的场景几何结构，从而使我们能够为每个观测结果渲染出真实分割掩码。 这些掩码能够识别每个物体的可见像素和关键特征（例如立方体上的标记或容器上的标签），其像素亮度可直接从接收到的图像中测量得出。 从物理轨迹中，我们还能提取出交互事件，包括抓取、掉落、最终静止姿态、打开的隔间以及印刻的墨迹。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 outlines the decision procedure. For each unit, we trace the sequence of events and identify the first error that was not subsequently repaired. Each task defines an ordered list of deterministic rules. We evaluate these rules sequentially to assign the failure family to each unit based on the first rule that matches. A failed recovery attempt is classified as an execution failure, whereas an unnoticed error is attributed to a wrong decision if the deciding evidence was observed by the agent, and to missing evidence if it was not. The entire procedure is programmatic and deterministic, evaluated directly on recorded run logs.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 概述了决策流程。 对于每个单元，我们追踪事件序列，并确定第一个未被后续修复的错误。 每个任务都定义了一个确定性规则的有序列表。 我们按顺序评估这些规则，根据第一个匹配的规则将故障族分配给每个单元。 失败的恢复尝试被归类为执行失败，而未察觉到的错误则归因于错误决策（如果决策依据的证据被智能体观察到）或证据缺失（如果该证据未被观察到）。 整个流程是程序化且确定性的，可直接基于记录的运行日志进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Several criteria are used to resolve edge cases between failure families. For premature terminations (stopping or submitting early), the unit is attributed to missing evidence if the agent stopped before observing the deciding evidence, and to a wrong decision if it stopped after observing the evidence. A failed physical attempt to uncover evidence (such as opening a drawer insufficiently) is attributed to execution failure rather than missing evidence. Finally, exploratory actions that perturb the scene (such as tipping a mug or rolling a test ball) are valid, so the unit is classified under side effect only to damage left unrepaired. Whether such damage was an unforeseen consequence or the result of clumsy execution cannot be determined from the recorded data.
paragraphs.zh: 使用若干标准来解决不同故障类别之间的边缘情况。 对于提前终止（提前停止或提交）的情况，如果智能体在观察到决定性证据之前停止，则将该单位归因于证据缺失；如果它在观察到证据之后停止，则归因于错误决策。 未能成功执行以揭示证据的物理尝试（例如未充分打开抽屉），应归因于执行失败，而非证据缺失。 最后，那些扰动场景的探索性动作（例如打翻杯子或滚动测试球）是有效的，因此该单位仅被归类为副作用，而造成的损坏则未被修复。 从记录的数据中无法判断此类损坏是意外后果，还是笨拙执行的结果。

paragraphs.en: To determine whether an object was observed by the agent ( Seen in Algorithm 1 ), we evaluate its visibility across the delivered camera views. The saved simulator state identifies which pixels belong to the object, and the delivered image gives their brightness. An object counts as observed when its pixel count and mean brightness both meet fixed thresholds, set to ≥ 150 \geq 150 visible pixels in one delivered image with mean brightness ≥ 25 \geq 25 ( ≥ 3 \geq 3 in Blackout Search). In Odd Parcel, a parcel counts as determined when the balance readings the agent saw are enough to determine whether the parcel is odd or normal. The remaining thresholds, the rules of every task and the per-unit labels are released with the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 为了判断某个物体是否被智能体观察到（见算法 1 中的“Seen”），我们会评估它在所有已提供的摄像头视角中的可见性。 保存的模拟器状态可以识别哪些像素属于该物体，而提供的图像则给出了这些像素的亮度值。 当某个物体的像素数量及其平均亮度均达到预设阈值时，即视为被观察到；具体阈值为：在一张提供的图像中至少有 ≥ 150 个可见像素，且平均亮度 ≥ 25（在“Blackout Search”任务中为 ≥ 3）。 在“Odd Parcel”任务中，当智能体观察到的余额读数足以判断该地块是奇数地块还是正常地块时，即视为已确定。 其余的阈值、各项任务的规则以及每个单位的标签都会随基准测试一同发布。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 separates failures in the two failure families (Missing evidence and Wrong decision) by the agent’s physical action. An object is considered as never placed if it remains in an unopened compartment or is put down short of its destination. An object is considered as placed wrongly if it is committed before deciding evidence is uncovered, or placed in contradiction to observed evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 根据智能体的物理动作，将两个故障类别（证据缺失和决策错误）中的故障进行了区分。 如果某个物体仍留在未打开的隔间中，或在其目的地之前被放下，则被视为从未放置。 如果某个物体在决定证据被揭示之前就被放置，或与观察到的证据相矛盾地被放置，则被视为错误放置。

sents.zh: 表 17 根据智能体的物理动作，将两个故障类别（证据缺失和决策错误）中的故障进行了区分。

sents.en: An object is considered as never placed if it remains in an unopened compartment or is put down short of its destination.
sents.zh: 如果某个物体仍留在未打开的隔间中，或在其目的地之前被放下，则被视为从未放置。

sents.en: An object is considered as placed wrongly if it is committed before deciding evidence is uncovered, or placed in contradiction to observed evidence.
sents.zh: 如果某个物体在决定证据被揭示之前就被放置，或与观察到的证据相矛盾地被放置，则被视为错误放置。
